articles.title: Tiny cyanobacteria may be the secret heroes of ocean carbon sequestration
articles.desc: A process known as the biological carbon pump (BCP) moves organic carbon from near the ocean's surface to the ocean floor. Scientists have thought that relatively large phytoplankton are more efficient at exporting carbon to the deep ocean than tiny cyanobacteria, but new research by Jingjing Zhang and colleagues published in AGU Advances now calls that belief into question.
